radiusSource: Radius 0.84 +/- 0.12 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-65 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJS..226....7C/abstract): 584,388 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
